items.question: 上个月的销售额是多少
items.gold_sql:
SELECT SUM(tl.quantity * tl.unit_price) AS value
FROM ticket_lines tl JOIN tickets t ON tl.ticket_id = t.ticket_id JOIN stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id JOIN skus k ON tl.sku_id = k.sku_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.sale_date) >= strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-01') - INTERVAL (0) MONTH)
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.sale_date) >= strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-01') - INTERVAL (0) MONTH)

WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.sale_date) >= strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-01') - INTERVAL (0) MONTH)

items.question: 各品类销售额
items.gold_sql:
SELECT k.category AS category, SUM(tl.quantity * tl.unit_price) AS value
FROM ticket_lines tl JOIN tickets t ON tl.ticket_id = t.ticket_id JOIN stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id JOIN skus k ON tl.sku_id = k.sku_id
WHERE TRUE
GROUP BY k.category
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

items.question: 近6个月各渠道销售额趋势

FROM ticket_lines tl JOIN tickets t ON tl.ticket_id = t.ticket_id JOIN stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id JOIN skus k ON tl.sku_id = k.sku_id
